source.title: Every Asset Its Own Benchmark: Market-Neutral Alpha in Perpetual Futures
source.author: Dhanya MD

hypothesis: Persistent aggressor-side buy pressure contains informed-flow information; perpetuals with higher trailing taker-buy imbalance outperform those with lower imbalance over the following week.
universe: Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals first listed by 2021-12-31, point-in-time availability, excluding BTCDOMUSDT
feature: 2 * sum(taker_buy_quote_volume) / sum(quote_volume) - 1 over trailing completed hours
liquidity_filter: top 80% by trailing 30-day quote volume, lagged one hour
construction: equal-weight long top quartile aggressor imbalance / short bottom quartile, 0.5 gross per side
fresh_confirmation: 2026 locked unless exploratory OOS success gate passes
development_gate: canonical net Sharpe >0.70, positive total return, at least 2/3 feature windows positive
success_gate: canonical exploratory OOS net Sharpe >1, positive return at 2x costs, at least 2/3 windows positive, both 2024 and 2025 non-negative
